propositions: A ticket-type mapping dictionary exists in duplicate form at two separate locations in adapters/, creating risk of silent divergence between Cloud and Datacenter deployments
The existing one-literal guard tests for status and priority maps do not cover the ticket-type map, leaving it unprotected against future re-duplication

Both copies must be consolidated into a single definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported under the historical private alias to preserve module-attribute resolution in external consumers
An AST-based boundary guard must be extended to detect and fail on any second dict literal defining the ticket-type map, matching the enforcement already applied to status and priority maps

The two existing copies are content-identical (same keys and values, differing only in key order which dicts do not preserve semantically), so consolidation is behaviour-preserving for both deployments
